title: A small presenting site representing a prescribed topos object and its slice
statement: Let $\mathcal E$ be a Grothendieck topos [def-weil-pbc-topos] in the universes of [def-weil-size-convention], and let $A$ be an object of $\mathcal E$. There are a small site $\mathcal C$ with finite limits and subcanonical topology (every representable presheaf is a sheaf), an equivalence of topoi $e:\mathcal E\simeq\operatorname{Sh}(\mathcal C)$, and an object $U\in\mathcal C$ with $e(A)\cong h_U$. With the localized topology on $\mathcal C/U$, there is an equivalence $\mathcal E/A\simeq\operatorname{Sh}(\mathcal C/U)$ under which the slice geometric inverse image $H\mapsto(H\times A\to A)$ corresponds to restriction $F\mapsto F|_U$. Here $h_U(V)=\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal C}(V,U)$ and a family in $\mathcal C/U$ covers precisely when its underlying family covers in $\mathcal C$.

source.place: Tag 03CI (lemma-topos-good-site), clauses (1), (3), (5), applied to the singleton family {A}; Tag 04GZ (lemma-localize-topos), statement and proof identifying Sh(C/U) with Sh(C)/h_U and inverse image with restriction.

proof.text: Choose a small sieve-site presentation b : E ≌ Sheaf J (Type w) from def-weil-pbc-topos. Work directly with this arbitrary Grothendieck topology: the already proved nerve comparison helpers in Sheaf.CategoryTheory.SheafSubcategoryComparison accept J without requiring a precoverage presentation or pullbacks on the original site. Thus no preliminary covering-site replacement is needed.

source.place: Tag 03CI, initial site presentation; the proved comparison implementation works directly with covering sieves.

proof.text: Apply the proved private generators theorem of Sheaf.CategoryTheory.ToposCompatibleGenerators to the w-small family indexed by D ⊕ PUnit consisting of all sheafified representables and b(A). That helper closes the family under terminal objects and pullbacks using ObjectProperty.limitsClosure and passes to SmallModel. It provides a w-small finite-limit category C and a fully faithful finite-limit-preserving F : C → Sheaf J, containing the family up to isomorphism. Each pullback square in C is sent to a pullback square by F. This is the finite-limit-closure construction used for the compatible-generators node, here with the prescribed object included in its input family.

source.place: Tag 03CI, full finite-limit closure of sheafified representables and the prescribed sheaf; existing proved generators helper.

proof.text: Use the proved arbitrary-sieve helpers epiPrecoverage, epiPrecoverage_site, epiPrecoverage_subcanonical, nerveToSheaf_isEquivalence and nerve_representable_sheaf_iso from Sheaf.CategoryTheory.SheafSubcategoryComparison. Their hypotheses are exactly fullness, faithfulness, containment of sheafified representables and the displayed pullback closure. They give the epimorphic precoverage K, its covering-site axioms, subcanonicity, and a nerve equivalence e₀. Choose U with F(U) ≅ b(A); mapping this isomorphism through e₀ and using the representable nerve isomorphism yields e(A) ≅ h_U for e = b.trans e₀. Transport binary products to E along e.

source.place: Tags 03A1 and 03CI; use the existing proved general-sieve comparison helpers, without the public theorem's unnecessary precoverage input.

proof.text: Subcanonicity makes the unit h_U → h_U^# an isomorphism. Compose Over.postEquiv e, change of base along e(A) ≅ h_U^#, and the inverse of the proved sliceEquivalence helper in Sheaf.CategoryTheory.Sites.LocalizedSetPullbackComparison. This gives s : Over A ≌ Sheaf (K.over U). The helper uses exactly the explicit fibre/extension equivalence of localized-sheaves-over-representable; no arbitrary equivalence lacking the fibre formula is chosen.

source.place: Tags 00Y1 and 04GZ; existing sliceEquivalence helper from the proved set-localization comparison.

proof.text: The private starPostIso constructed in this proof uses PreservesLimitPair.iso and prod.mapIso to identify Over.star A after transport with Over.star h_U^#. Its naturality follows by composing with both product projections. The private starTensorIso identifies chosen binary products with the sectionwise cartesian tensor products using tensorLeftIsoProd and uniqueness of product cones. Compose these isomorphisms with the existing proved restrictionFibreIso: the fibre of h_U^# × H over the section eta(a) is sent to H by second projection, with inverse x ↦ (eta(a), x). This supplies k : Over.star A ⋙ s.functor ≅ e.functor ⋙ K.overPullback U, naturally in H.

source.place: Tag 04GZ, product inverse-image formula; Tag 03CF product/fibre calculation, already proved as restrictionFibreIso.

proof.text: The forgetful site functor C/U → C is continuous and cocontinuous by the existing Mathlib Sites.Over instances. Mathlib Functor.sheafAdjunctionCocontinuous therefore gives restriction as a left adjoint to the cocontinuous pushforward. Compose with e.toAdjunction and s.symm.toAdjunction. The unit of s and k identify this transported left adjoint with Over.star A, so Adjunction.ofNatIsoLeft supplies its right adjoint. Over.star A also is the right adjoint of Over.forget A, and therefore preserves finite limits. Package this adjunction and preservation as the geometric morphism g, whose inverse is definitionally Over.star A; k is the required restriction comparison.

source.place: Section 00XZ and Tag 00XR, via Mathlib sheafAdjunctionCocontinuous; Tag 04GZ. Both adjunctions and their transports are constructed explicitly.

proof_origin.place: J2 Lean proof of Tags 03CI/03A1 and 04GZ, reusing the fully proved private generator, arbitrary-sieve nerve comparison, slice equivalence and product-fibre helpers through private import all. Mathlib supplies the cocontinuous sheaf adjunction directly. The theorem has only propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound as axioms.
